usg_jcrQuery.ui.tooltip: Listing component. Automatically queries and renders content by type.
usg_jcrQuery.type.ui.tooltip: Which content to list (only types that opt in via usgmix:queryContent appear here).
usg_jcrQuery.maxItems.ui.tooltip: Leave empty to show all results.
usg_jcrQuery.startNode.ui.tooltip: Optional: limit results to descendants of this node.
usg_jcrQuery.filter.ui.tooltip: Optional: only show items tagged with these categories.
usg_jcrQuery.noResultText.ui.tooltip: Text shown when no items match the query.
usg_jcrQuery.j:linkType.ui.tooltip: Optional link shown at the top-right of the listing (e.g. "See all articles").
usg_jcrQuery.loadMore.ui.tooltip: Show a "Load more" button instead of rendering all results at once.
usg_jcrQuery.categoryFilter.ui.tooltip: Show category filter chips above the listing.
usg_gridRow.ui.tooltip: Layout container that arranges child components in a responsive CSS grid.

editHint.title: Facet Filter
editHint.description: {{count}} facet(s) configured. The dropdowns are populated dynamically from the search index at runtime.

usg_facetFilter.ui.tooltip: Interactive filter bar. Each facet entry is pipe-separated: field|label|searchSignature|endpoint.
usg_facetFilter.facets.ui.tooltip: One entry per facet dropdown. Format: fieldName|Label|searchSignature|/lang/sxa/search/facets/
